plugin.name: Glad You're Here
plugin.description:
Hugging someone with Glad You're Here lowers your Stress and Fear stress:
Your children: -25 Your spouse or lover: -18 Good friends (confidant or ally): -10 Followers, strangers and pets: -5
You get a short "The hug eases your stress." notification when it works. Stress never goes below 0.
Needs ImGladYoureHere.esp (Glad You're Here 3.6) and Stress and Fear.esp (Stress and Fear 2.07), plus SKSE. ESL-flagged, so it uses no plugin slot. Load order doesn't matter. Safe to add to an existing save.
